import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *

def reqf(frm="sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t", to="sip:bob@lab.test", cid="demo",
         cseq="7 MESSAGE", extra=None, body=b"", method="MESSAGE", uri="sip:bob@lab.test"):
    hs = [("From", frm), ("To", to), ("Call-ID", cid), ("CSeq", cseq), ("Content-Length", str(len(body)))]
    if extra: hs.extend(extra)
    return mkreq(method=method, uri=uri, headers=hs, body=body)

def run_evs(evs, cfg=None):
    rc, out, err = run(envelope(evs, cfg))
    assert rc == 0, (rc, err[:300])
    return json.loads(out)

# commitment equivalence: PPI=[default] vs no PPI -> identical commitments -> replay
A = reqf(extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>")], body=b"q")
B = reqf(body=b"q")
d = run_evs([ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",h(A)), ev(1,"edge","alice","internal",h(B))])
expect("PPI==default commitment replay", d["results"][1]["decision"] == "replay", d["results"])

# ...but a PPI with a different alias is a conflict
C = reqf(extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity", "<sip:desk@lab.test>")], body=b"q")
d = run_evs([ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",h(A)), ev(1,"edge","alice","internal",h(C))])
expect("PPI different alias conflict", d["results"][1]["reason"] == "conflict", d["results"])

# access PAI spelling never matters for the commitment
D = reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:whatever@else.test>")], body=b"q")
E = reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", '"X" <tel:+1112223333>')], body=b"q")
d = run_evs([ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",h(D)), ev(1,"edge","alice","internal",h(E))])
expect("access PAI spelling irrelevant", d["results"][1]["decision"] == "replay", d["results"])

# display-name spelling never matters
F = reqf(frm='"Some Name" <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t', body=b"q")
G = reqf(frm="sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t", body=b"q")
d = run_evs([ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",h(F)), ev(1,"edge","alice","internal",h(G))])
expect("display spelling irrelevant", d["results"][1]["decision"] == "replay", d["results"])

# percent spelling / case / leading zeros / header order / folding irrelevant
H = mkreq(uri="SIP:%62ob@LAB.test:05060", headers=[("l","1"),("CSEQ","0007   MESSAGE"),("i","demo"),("t","<SIP:bob@lab.test:5060>"),("F","Alice <sip:alice@lab.test> ; tag = t")], body=b"q")
I = mkreq(method="MESSAGE", uri="sip:bob@lab.test:5060", headers=[("From","sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t"),("To","sip:bob@lab.test:5060"),("Call-ID","demo"),("CSeq","7 MESSAGE"),("Content-Length","1")], body=b"q")
d = run_evs([ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",h(H)), ev(1,"edge","alice","internal",h(I))])
expect("lexical equivalence replay", d["results"][1]["decision"] == "replay", d["results"])

# exact key set of accept records
d = run_evs([ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",h(I))])
r = d["results"][0]
expect("accept key set", set(r.keys()) == {"index","decision","first","account","identity","from","pai","method","target","call_id","cseq","tag","privacy","body_sha256"}, sorted(r.keys()))
expect("reject key set", True)
d2 = run_evs([ev(0,"edge","alice","internal","zz")])
expect("reject key set", set(d2["results"][0].keys()) == {"index","decision","reason"}, d2["results"][0])
expect("top-level key set", set(d2.keys()) == {"results","accepted","replayed","rejected","live"}, d2.keys())

# all rejected -> still exit 0
rc, out, err = run(envelope([ev(0,"edge","alice","internal","zz"), ev(1,"edge",None,"internal","")]))
expect("all rejected exit 0", rc == 0 and json.loads(out)["rejected"] == 2, (rc, out[:80]))

# body_sha256 correctness
b = b"hello world"
req = reqf(body=b)
d = run_evs([ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",h(req))])
expect("body sha", d["results"][0]["body_sha256"] == sha(b), d["results"][0]["body_sha256"])

# INVITE and MESSAGE with same call-id/cseq are distinct keys
Iv = reqf(method="INVITE", cseq="7 INVITE")
Ms = reqf(method="MESSAGE", cseq="7 MESSAGE")
d = run_evs([ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",h(Iv)), ev(1,"edge","alice","internal",h(Ms))])
expect("method distinct keys", d["results"][1]["decision"] == "accept" and d["live"] == 2, d["results"])

# CSeq numeric equality: 7 vs 0007 same key (already shown); 7 vs 8 distinct
d = run_evs([ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",h(reqf(cseq="7 MESSAGE"))), ev(1,"edge","alice","internal",h(reqf(cseq="8 MESSAGE")))])
expect("cseq distinct keys", d["results"][1]["decision"] == "accept", d["results"])

# relay: PAI list order in commitment (sip-first ordering applied before compare)
R1 = reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity","<sip:alice@lab.test>,<tel:+12025550100>")])
R2 = reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity","<tel:+12025550100>,<sip:alice@lab.test>")])
d = run_evs([ev(0,"trunk",None,"internal",h(R1)), ev(1,"trunk",None,"internal",h(R2))])
expect("PAI order-insensitive commitment", d["results"][1]["decision"] == "replay", d["results"])
summary()
PYEOF
